NOT cartoon, not anime, not doll, no beautification redesign. Transparent RGBA canvas exactly 1024x1536. EXACTLY 4 columns and 6 rows, 24 isolated waist-up half-body cutouts of the SAME adult woman, even grid, generous 15px external margins and transparent gutters. Every figure from top of head to waist, arms contained naturally in each slot; straight clean waist-level bottom crop, no legs, no table, no room or furniture, no background, no floor shadows, no labels, no text. Same frontal eye-level camera, same face size and body scale, same soft daylight, outfit, hair and skin across all 24 figures. Each row is four small sequential variations, not different people. Keep the top of head and waist crop at consistent heights in every cell so animation does not jump; subtle natural movement, mouth mostly closed, not lip-sync. All 24 cutouts must be separate connected silhouettes, no overlapping cells. Fully transparent outside the figures, not a checkerboard drawing.
layout: 4 columns × 6 rows; 24 frames; normalized to 320 × 420; 2 fps
